text:
incident-bot: Pager alert -> high p99 for streaming on prod (route: /v1/stream/generate). Paging @matt @sarah @anika :rotating_light:

matt: getting 95th ~450ms but p99s jumping to 1.8s for a subset of requests since 03:09 UTC. spikes correlate with long-context streams (~>1024 tokens).

sarah: saw the automated precision rollout at 03:07 -> fp8-dynamic-v3 applied to several clusters (rolled by calibrator). Could be related.

anika: logs show repeated KV cache misses + `dequantize` path falling back, then increased GPU kernel latency. snippet:```
[03:09:12] kv_cache: miss key=conv-xxxxxxxx
[03:09:12] dequantize: fallback to fp16 path; latency=1.2s
[03:09:13] stream: stalled waiting for dequant queue
```

matt: interesting — the fallback path looks more expensive for long streams. p95 increased slightly too after rollout.

tariq: I'm oncall for infra, spinning up. Are we seeing any memory pressure or OOMs?

anika: memory stable. GPU util bouncing, but the root is lots of small kv evictions triggering dequant fallback thrash. Quant profile changed weight zeros->packed layout and the decoder kernel path chooses a slower dequant when the profile flags mismatch.

cs-jordan: two customers opened tickets for "streaming stalls" around 03:11, both report repeated chunk gaps / pauses. ETA to customers?

sarah: short mitigation plan: 1) route new streaming requests to non-quantized variant (model=redwood-llama-fp16) 2) throttle max concurrent streams per session 3) pin affected hosts to previous precision profile.

deploy-bot: @sarah executed: `redwoodctl route update --from fp8-dynamic-v3 --to fp16-shard --weight 100 --selector=streaming` -> routing change started. (job id: 0x8f3a)

matt: confirmed new streams are landing on fp16-shard, p99 for those requests back to ~380ms. streaming backlog processing continues on old hosts though.

anika: applying hotpatch to kv cache config on affected pool to increase retention window (temp fix). patch:```
cache.kv.max_entries: 20000
cache.kv.eviction_policy: lru
```

tariq: scaled affected DP pool from 8->12 nodes to drain backlog: `kubectl scale deployment/rt-pool-quant --replicas=12 -n redwood-prod`

matt: note: calibration agent previously applied a micro-batch quant optimization that reduces prefix caching — looks like unintended interaction. Opening ticket with research.

cs-jordan: sending proactive note to the 2 customers now: telling them we routed new streams to fp16 and are processing caught-up requests, ETA ~30m for full recovery.

anika: additional mitigation: disabled the calibrator's aggressive pack routine for the fp8-dynamic-v3 profile so new allocations use legacy layout. command: `calibratorctl profiles disable-feature fp8-dynamic-v3.pack-optim`

matt: after disabling pack-optim and routing, tail p99 has been steadily dropping. p99 window shows breach lasted ~27 minutes, p95 breach ~12 minutes.

sarah: can we get a short post-incident note with root cause + steps? I can draft. Include: 1) calibration change (fp8-dynamic-v3) introduced incompatible memory layout leading to dequant fallback 2) fallback path slower for long-context streams causing KV thrash & tail latency 3) mitigations applied: routing to fp16, increased KV retention, scaled pool, disabled pack optim 4) customer outreach and monitoring updates.

tariq: handoff -> I'll be on until 07:00 UTC, then anika will take overnight. leaving runbook steps in incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. Severity: Sev2. Alert duration: 00:32:00.

matt: leaving logs + traces here for postmortem: `s3://redwood-incidents/2187654321/` (contains profiler slices for dequant paths).

anika: quick note for the postmortem: surface a test harness that simulates long streaming sessions with kv churn + quant profile toggles. we need CI guard.

cs-jordan: update sent to customers: "We have routed new streams to fp16 and applied fixes; monitoring shows latency recovering; we'll follow up with a timeline and root cause." :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rollback action id 0x8f3a -> closed. routing fully on fp16-shard.

matt: ok handing to tariq/anika for monitoring. if anything regresses ping @sarah directly.

tariq: taking over monitoring. will post an update in 30m.

anika: taking overnight handoff at 06:45 UTC. final note: keep calibrator disabled for fp8-dynamic-v3 until research signoff.

incident-bot: Thread closed by matt at 03:52 UTC.
